name: Mailroom Approvals
description: Build evolving Agent Responsibility Profiles, route Outlook email to the best OpenClaw agent, draft with authorized context, and manage human approval in Telegram.

pythonPath.description: Optional Python module root. Defaults to the package's bundled python directory.

telegramChatId.description: Telegram chat authorized to approve Mailroom actions.

reviewOwners.description: OpenClaw agent IDs used when routingOwnerMode is selected. Also retained as an upgrade fallback.

routingOwnerMode.description: Make every profiled/discovered OpenClaw agent routable, or only reviewOwners.

profilesPath.description: Effective responsibility-profile JSON. Must end in current.json; defaults to ~/.openclaw/mailroom/responsibility-profiles/current.json.

accounts.description: Optional map of friendly account IDs to mailbox email addresses.

connectionsPath.description: Path to OpenClaw's Outlook connection registry.
